next_gate.branch_contract: pure survival and damage/resource branches start at the same immutable root and regenerate their causal futures
next_gate.join_key: content digest + stage/gameplay epoch + enemy generation + root subroutine + VM PC + lifecycle event + item allocation/pickup + hostile births + viable action certificate

selection_contract.consumer_rule: select more than one immutable root/event family, then run same-root exact survival versus damage/resource ablations
selection_contract.method: exact immutable-key intersection and named cohorts
